周大福「Celebrate Love」情人節精選首飾

縱使天上繁星無數，隨四季改變軌跡，唯獨北極星堅守原地照耀漆黑無際的夜空，如同從一而終的愛情。 周大福「星旅」系列T MARK美鑽首飾以北極星星軌為設計藍本，刻劃出星河獨有的魅惑，帶領戀人走上真愛旅程。今個情人節，由泰妹及Stone以北極星訴說戀愛的意義，一起閃耀永恒愛情。 Celebrate Love. As the legend goes, the Lodestar is a metaphor of everlasting and unwavering love, protecting and blessing countless lovers on Earth. Taking from the inspiration, Chow Tai Fook “Lodestar” Collection resembles luminous galaxy and shimmering sparkles guiding lovers to the journey of true love. This Valentine’s Day, let your love shine bright with sparkling diamonds of commitment.
